title: Avocet
blurb: The four species of avocets are a genus, Recurvirostra, of waders in the same avian family as the stilts. The genus name comes from Latin recurvus, 'curved backwards' and rostrum, 'bill'.
facts: The common name is thought to derive from the Italian (Ferrarese) word avosetta, which may relate to Latin avis ("bird").
Francis Willughby in 1678 noted the "Avosetta of the Italians".
